environment: Codex in-app browser; Next.js development server; 1280 x 720; DPR 1.5; night lighting
method: Development-only renderer diagnostics. Counts include shadow and main passes. The frame timer measures CPU submission time, not GPU completion.
changes: Nearby detail radius reduced from 42 to 28 world units to avoid waking neighboring biomes at the house.
Distant tree crowns use 12 x 8 segments; nearby crowns retain 28 x 20.
Rounded box geometry reduced from 716 to 300 triangles per box.
48 keycaps share an instanced draw; 33 net strands share an instanced draw.
limits: Triangle counts are rounded to the nearest thousand.
CPU samples vary with host/browser load; they are not a controlled hardware benchmark.
Actual old-M1 hardware has not been measured.
The world animation driver intentionally targets about 30 fps.
